lines.text: All the nations are called to praise the LORD because His loving devotion toward us is great.
Israel, the house of David, and those who fear the LORD are called to say His loving devotion endures forever.
The nations surrounded him and swarmed like bees, but in the name of the LORD he cut them off.
He asks for the gates of Zion to open to give thanks, and the rejected stone becomes the cornerstone.
He prays for the LORD to save us and says the LORD is God, whose light shines upon us.
